accepted.reason: First local account created by Windows setup (OOBE): the subject is the machine account, the account is the one the owner chose at install. Expected once per new machine.
OneDrive updater: RunOnce "Uninstall <version>" removes the old version folder at next logon (cmd.exe rmdir). Written by the OneDrive setup running from %TEMP%.

K-Lite Codec Pack installer (Inno Setup, extracted to %TEMP%\is-*.tmp) creates its update task from an XML file. Installers from %TEMP% cannot be filtered in the rule (attackers run from %TEMP% too), so this one is accepted by name.
grpconv (Windows Program Group Converter) RunOnce set by an installer. Built-in Windows binary with a fixed argument.

Spotify (per-user install in AppData) registers itself in HKCU Run. A per-user app in a user-writable folder is exactly what malware also does, so the rule is not changed; the exact app + path is accepted for this machine only.
